items.title: Albert "Baby Brousse" Broussard Interview, 1961-02-20
items.q: The interviewee confirms living across from Stanko, but the interviewer is the one who establishes the connection to Lettler ('He worked for Lettler...'). The interviewee does not mention any personal interaction, employment, or musical collaboration with Lettler.

ctx.x: Yeah, Frank Carbone. And he really played nice trumpet.

He worked for Lettler, Ye, and Phillip. He worked for Lettler, Ye, and Phillip. That's right. And he... He used to live on St. Peter, between me and I talked to you. Right next door to us. Across the street from Stanko. Across the street from Stanko. From Stanko.
That's where we were living. That's right. Right across from Stanko. That's where...
